text:
I spent one month in Pattaya and came across Seoul Clinic Thailand by chance.
After my first consultation with Dr. Wannasiri Limsuknirun, I decided to undergo a deep plane facelift combined with a chin reduction.
Following the surgery, I regularly attended HBOT (Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy) sessions almost daily for the remaining three weeks.
I must say that the surgery was performed extremely precisely and professionally – I had almost no visible bruising. Thanks to the oxygen therapy, the healing process was incredibly fast. When I returned home, nobody could even tell that I had undergone surgery just three weeks earlier.
Above all, I would like to sincerely thank the entire team. Everyone was very kind, professional, and supportive. It was truly a pleasure to visit the clinic every day – they made the whole experience very positive and comfortable.
I will not forget you and I will definitely come back.
Kind regards,
Richard

restaurant_name: Seoul Clinic Thailand (Pattaya) โซลคลินิก ไทยแลนด์ 美容护肤中心
text:
Seoul Clinic Thailand in Pattaya delivered a great experience with their oxygen treatment. The procedure itself was professionally handled and the results were impressive. The staff was knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything properly before and during the treatment, making sure we felt comfortable and well informed throughout the entire process. The clinic is clean, modern, and well equipped, creating a professional environment that inspires confidence.

The treatment itself was thorough and well executed, showing that the team knows exactly what they are doing. You could tell this is a clinic that takes its services seriously and invests in both the equipment and the expertise needed to deliver quality results. The overall experience from booking to walking out the door was smooth and well organized.

The one issue that holds this place back from a full five stars is the 3% surcharge for card payments. In this day and age, charging customers extra for paying by card feels outdated and unnecessarily penalizing. Card payment has become the standard method of transaction for most people, especially international visitors who may not always carry large amounts of cash. Adding a surcharge on top of the treatment price leaves a sour taste and feels like a hidden extra cost that should either be absorbed into the pricing or eliminated entirely.

It is a shame because everything else about the experience was excellent. The treatment, the staff, the facilities, all top notch. But when you finish a great treatment feeling positive and then get hit with an unexpected surcharge at the payment counter, it takes some of that goodwill away.

Four stars because the clinic delivers quality treatments in a professional setting with a great team. Drop the card surcharge and this would be an easy five. In 2026 customers should not be penalized for choosing to pay by card.
